title: Workflow [VACUUM]
description:
## VACUUM
When you DELETE rows or DROP tables, SQLite doesn't actually shrink the file. The space is marked as free but the file stays the same size.

`VACUUM` rebuilds the entire database file, reclaiming that wasted space.
```sql
VACUUM;
```

When to use it:
- After deleting lots of data
- After dropping large tables
- When the database file is much larger than the actual data


---
## Question:
What does VACUUM actually do?
b1t: Deletes all data from all tables
b2t: Rebuilds the database file to reclaim unused space
b3t: Speeds up queries by creating indexes
b4t: Backs up the database to a new file
